origin: Original frozen C API, original GGUF writer and scalar quantizers. Expected data is never generated by the Rust implementation.

contract.graph: Frozen StarCoder learned positions and StarCoder2 full-head NeoX RoPE, affine LayerNorm, sequential biased GELU FFN, F32 contiguous KV, one worker, nonflash. Any failed comparison is diagnosed before changing acceptance.

scope: 43 executable synthetic variants and 29 checked rejection/unsupported boundaries. This corpus does not establish pretrained StarCoder/StarCoder2 quality, flash, scaled RoPE, per-layer arrays, noncausal inference or full native C contexts.
